name: NGC 1339 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 1339, an elliptical galaxy in the Fornax Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc1339-hubble
story: An elliptical galaxy among the early-type members of the Fornax Cluster, imaged in a Hubble survey of the cluster's galaxies and the globular star clusters that swarm around them.

claims.text: FCC 63 is NGC 1339, type E4 (elliptical), at RA 03 28 06.55, Dec -32 17 05.87
It is one of the early-type galaxies in Fornax imaged by the ACS Fornax Cluster Survey
The survey measures globular clusters associated with these galaxies
